basic_info.name: Guild.ai
basic_info.description: Guild is the control plane for AI agents, giving organizations one place to see how AI is being used, control what it can access and cost, and run reliable agents in production.With Guild Insights, leaders can understand AI adoption and spending across teams, users, agents, models, and platforms—including Cursor, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Guild. Organizations can forecast costs, set budgets, stop unexpected spending with circuit breakers, and identify opportunities to optimize models and tools.Through Guild’s governed runtime and Agent Hub, teams can discover, build, deploy, and share production-ready agents with identity, permissions, observability, and auditability built in. Guild is code-first, model-agnostic, vendor-neutral, and designed to work with the tools, APIs, models, and frameworks teams already use.

basic_info.name: Rowspace
basic_info.description: Rowspace exists to help financial firms make faster, sharper decisions by turning their proprietary data into a compounding edge. The best investors have spent decades building institutional judgment, but that knowledge gets trapped across memos, models, emails, and legacy systems. We put that data to work.Our platform connects structured and unstructured data across a firm's entire history, applies a finance-native lens that reflects how that firm actually thinks and operates, and delivers intelligence wherever teams work, whether that's our own interface, Excel, Microsoft Teams, or a firm's existing data infrastructure.

basic_info.name: Pi Security
basic_info.description: Pi is an agentic product security platform for organizations tired of sacrificing security for velocity, and velocity for security.Codebases grow larger and teams grow faster, and AI-generated code adds volume and velocity no human team could match. Security stops being a function and becomes a bottleneck. The tools keep getting smarter at finding problems, but nobody has built a system that remembers them. Pi does. Fix an issue once and it stays fixed everywhere, not just in the one spot you found it. The decisions your team makes are kept and reused, so your security posture compounds with every fix instead of resetting after every incident.We believe security should only get better with time. It shouldn't degrade when an engineer leaves or a codebase scales. Every lesson your organization has ever learned should stay learned. And with Pi, it can.Secure software as fast as you build it.
